title: Insulation Rebates in Fort St. John 2026: Up to $5,500 from BC Hydro
desc: Fort St. John has the coldest winters of any BC city we cover, with January lows near -15°C. BC Hydro's insulation formula, eligibility and a worked attic example.
h1: Insulation Rebates in Fort St. John
lead: Fort St. John has the coldest winters of any city in our BC list. Insulation costs the same here as anywhere, but it pays back faster when the January low is -15°C.
cards_heading: What BC Hydro pays for insulation in Fort St. John
cards_intro: We re-read BC Hydro's insulation page on October 2, 2026. The rebate is for homes heated mainly by electricity. If your home uses natural gas, check whether FortisBC or another gas company serves you before you assume that program applies.

cards.title: Attic
cards.amount: $0.02 x R added x sq ft
cards.note: Capped at $900, at least R12 added.

cards.title: Walls and basement
cards.amount: $0.09 x R added x sq ft
cards.note: Capped at $1,200 each for wall cavity, sheathing, and basement or crawlspace.

cards.title: Floors and other spots
cards.amount: $0.07 x R added x sq ft
cards.note: Capped at $1,000, at least R20 added.

cards.title: More than one upgrade
cards.note: For finishing more than one eligible upgrade.

after_cards:
A Fort St. John 1970s bungalow

A 1,200 square foot attic at R-12 brought to R-50 adds R-38. The formula gives 0.02 x 38 x 1,200 = $912, so the $900 cap applies. Adding R-12 to 800 square feet of wall cavity pays 0.09 x 12 x 800 = $864. The total is $1,764, by our arithmetic.
sections: The coldest city in our BC list

Fort St. John's average January low from 2015 to 2024 was -15.0°C, and the coldest day was -42.2°C. That is 5 degrees colder than Prince George on average and the coldest low in our list. A heating system runs flat out for weeks. Heat that leaks through an old attic does not take a day off.
Fort St. John's homes in numbers

The 2021 Census counted 8,775 households in Fort St. John. Of those, 3,690 (42%) live in homes built before 1981, and 2,035 are owner-occupied detached houses from that period. Half the households live in detached houses and 42% rent. About 7.5% say their home needs major repairs, the highest share in our BC list.

If you rent, the account holder applies. Anyone else needs the account holder's signed consent form.

BC Hydro's rebate is only for homes heated mainly by electricity. A natural gas, oil or propane home is not eligible. Gas customers can look at their gas company's rebates. FortisBC lists the same formula for its own gas customers, so check which company serves your address.

BC Hydro accepts batts, loose fill, board and spray foam. In a cold climate, compare quotes by finished R-value and ask how the contractor will handle air sealing, since leaks can waste a good attic layer. The rebate cannot exceed the invoice cost.

BC Hydro sends income-qualified customers to the CleanBC Better Homes Energy Savings Program instead, and the two cannot be combined. The 2026 program document lists no insulation or window rebates, so for lower incomes the free Energy Conservation Assistance Program is the route to ask about.

• The home must be at least 12 months old and a primary residence.
  • An HPCN member must do the work.
  • Fix pest and moisture problems first.
  • Apply within six months of the invoice date.

We did not find Fort St. John insulation companies in our Google review data, so there is no ranked list on this page. Use BC Hydro's contractor search.
claim_heading: How to claim in Fort St. John
claim_steps: Confirm your heat is mainly electric and the BC Hydro account is in your name.
Ask for quotes listing the R-value added and area.
Add another upgrade to check the bonus.
faq: How cold does Fort St. John get?
The average January low from 2015 to 2024 was -15.0°C and the coldest day was -42.2°C.
Can I claim with gas heat?
Not through BC Hydro. Check your gas company, such as FortisBC if it serves your address.
How much can an attic earn?
Up to $900, and the new layer must add at least R12.
The account holder applies. Anyone else needs a signed consent form from the account holder.
